newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine 6-mo T-bills yield falls to 62.29 pct.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine 6-mo T-bills yield falls to 62.29 pct.

text.p: The average yield at the latest auction of six-month discount treasury bills fell to 62.29 percent from 64.38 percent at the last sale on September 4, a central bank statement said on Friday.
The results of Thursday's auction, compared to the last issue of six-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 34.194 million UAH 26.420 million UAH
Actual amount raised 26.089 million UAH 22.385 million UAH
The central bank sold 341,948 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 306,056 were competitive and 35,892 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for September 10.
